description: Task Engine lifecycle event type 'taskCreated'. Published when a task is created (atomic with the insert and its initial timers). Derived from the Event Broker base event type; routed to the task_events topic and partitioned by subject (the task ID) for per-task ordering.

type.$comment: Pins the event-type identifier so an editor can validate a payload against this schema alone.

task_type.description: GTS type of the created task.

queue.description: Queue the task was enqueued into.

urgency.description: Dispatch class (PRD cpt-cf-task-engine-fr-priority-dispatch): 'critical' is served before 'normal' and needs the expedite action. Consumers MUST treat an unknown value as Unknown (enum evolution rules).

priority.description: Effective task priority, 0 (highest) to 1000 (lowest). Orders only this tenant's own tasks within the queue and urgency class.

created_by.description: Authenticated subject that created the task.

initial_state.description: State the task entered on creation.

resource_refs.description: The task's resource references (PRD cpt-cf-task-engine-fr-resource-refs), carried on task-scoped events so consumers can route per resource without a read-back.

resource_type.description: GTS type identifier of the referenced resource.

verified.description: True only if a creator check of the task type confirmed, at creation, that the creator may act on this resource (PRD cpt-cf-task-engine-fr-resource-refs). False means the reference is the creator's unverified claim; consumers MUST NOT treat it as proof of access.
